description: Pinned versions of the build and gate toolchain (D-069 item 12). scripts/cloud/toolchain.json keeps only the checksums keyed by these versions.

toolchain.claude_cli_version.description: Claude Code CLI release the cloud sessions run (observed with `claude --version`); recorded for the cache key and reproducibility, not installed by setup.

toolchain.gitleaks_version.description: gitleaks release used by the secret-scanning stage.

toolchain.node_version.description: Node.js release the gate, the cloud setup and the cache key run on.

toolchain.observed_tools.description: Tools whose installed version is observed into the attested toolchain_id (cache keys, v4 proof observed_versions). chromium (a Playwright browser) left with its probe (vazão F54): the engine drives none since OU-DECOUPLE F5 (D-113). gh and the Vercel CLI left the toolchain (vazão F6), pnpm too (vazão F16).

toolchain.postgres_revision.description: theseus-rs/postgresql-binaries revision that carries the pinned PostgreSQL build.

toolchain.postgres_version.description: PostgreSQL release of the local test database.

toolchain.python_release_tag.description: python-build-standalone release tag that carries the pinned CPython build.

toolchain.python_version.description: Standalone CPython release the engine scripts run on.

toolchain.ruff_version.description: ruff release used by the lint ratchet (PADRAO-DEV F4b): the Python lint the gate runs on every change.
